description: A complete, minimal Orbit plugin. Demonstrates the install handshake, the SDK, per-store settings, CRUD against the plugin's own database, inbound webhooks, billing, and a background worker.

permissions.description: Poll for orders that changed since the last sync
Read order detail, and required for order.* webhook topics
Browse the store's catalogue — a separate scope from product:read, which alone will not list
Match your records to Orbit products
Subscribe to order events so work is push-driven, not polled
Check existing subscriptions so restarts do not duplicate them
Check whether this store is subscribed, before running the paid part
Replace a subscription whose URL has changed — only one per topic is allowed, so the stale one must go first

_pricingNote: Display summary for the store listing ONLY. It does not create anything billable — sellable plans and prices are configured on the plugin's detail page in the partner dashboard. Models: free | one_time | subscription (with optional trialDays).
